**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- Test-only, two lines in `crates/ui/tests/theme_files.rs:60-61`: the stale literals (`35.0`, `10.5`) now compare against `Tokens::DARK`, which matches the test's own comment ("keep the dark column's numbers") and cannot go stale again.
- No product code, dependencies, build.rs, scripts or snapshot PNGs touched. Body is complete: `Changelog: none`, `Fixes #932`, conventional subject.

**Local results (merged with current upstream main; already up to date)**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test theme_files` (CWD crates/ui) | 14 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --tests -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**: none.

**Notes (not blocking)**: none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 7123011df9992ab5ed1db162c32592513913e052 -->
**Independent read-only review (no build, no cargo, no worktree): Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

I read the diff and the files on `main` through `gh api`; I did not build or run the tests. The earlier review on this head was posted from the author's account, so this is a second read.

**What checks out**
- Scope: the diff is exactly two assertions in `crates/ui/tests/theme_files.rs` (lines 60-61). No other file, no snapshot PNG, no product code.
- Body: `Fixes #932` and `Changelog: none` are present. `mergeable` is `MERGEABLE`.
- Not vacuous: `assets/themes/teal-night.json` sets only `accent`, `accent_hover`, `selection_bg`, `selection_stroke`, `radius_widget` and `glyph_px`. `cell_h` and `font_row_suffix` are not set by the file, so they come from the `dark` base. The new comparisons check that base value against `Tokens::DARK`, a separate constant, so they are not `x == x`. An overlay that wrongly changed `cell_h` or `font_row_suffix` would fail them.
- Values on `main`: `Tokens::DARK.cell_h` is `40.0` (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/theme.rs:145`) and `Tokens::DARK.font_row_suffix` is `11.5` (line 151). #767 (merged 2026-11-11) moved both from `35.0` and `10.5` in the dark column, and the light column moved too (lines 187, 193). The PR's new assertions match that.

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The comparison ties this test to `Tokens::DARK` rather than a fixed literal. That is what the PR intends, but it means a future dark retune will not fail this test. The `ink` assertion beside it still uses a literal, so the test is mixed. Fine as is.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
